release_notes: Improved the skill rating snapshot system so skill history is now recorded per completed round instead of only after a practice series using the latest round.
Historical skill calculations now support accurate as-of snapshots, making the skill development chart more precise and useful over time.
Added profile-specific automatic and manual backup management, including backup listing, manifest metadata, restore confirmation and pre-restore safety backups.
Improved SQLite shutdown handling by checkpointing WAL data during clean application shutdown.
Polished the main control/status area and backup window layout for a cleaner and more readable user interface.
Added and updated regression tests for backup handling, per-round skill snapshots, serial status behaviour and related UI changes.
Includes general bug fixes and small UI improvements around status messages, serial connection display and statistics-related behaviour.
